root.description: The absolute path of the knowledge root the note was read from; joined with `path` it is the note's source location.

path.description: The note's path relative to the knowledge root.

title.description: The frontmatter title when the note declares one, else its filename.

noteId.description: The CerebralHelm note id from frontmatter; absent for a note authored elsewhere.

frontmatter.description: The note's frontmatter exactly as parsed, including keys CerebralHelm does not write — the file is the source of truth, so nothing in it is dropped on the way out.

body.description: The Markdown body, verbatim, with the frontmatter block removed. Redacted out of the operational log by the descriptor: a note body never reaches a tool_calls row.

updated.description: ISO-8601. The frontmatter `updated` when present, else the file's modification date.
